name: cogniforge-desktop
description: COGNIFORGE desktop app -- an Electron shell around the same WebXR/Three.js frontend, installable on Windows/macOS/Linux and (via WebXR passthrough on a tethered/Link-connected headset) usable on VR hardware without a separate native VR codebase.

scripts.dist: npm run build:frontend && npm run copy:frontend && electron-builder
